check_box.label: Enable Atmo Magic weather
check_box.tool_tip: Master switch. Weather still only runs on tracks that have been given a configuration

combo_box.name: track_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Weather is configured per EEP sky track and only runs for the track your camera is in

check_box.name: track_follow_check
check_box.label: Follow camera
check_box.tool_tip: Keep this panel on whichever track the camera is currently in

text.name: track_status_text
text.tool_tip: Where the configuration currently in force came from

check_box.name: track_enabled_check
check_box.label: This track has weather
check_box.tool_tip: Tracks have no weather until one is defined. Parcel notecards override anything set here

slider.name: precip_slider
slider.label: Precipitation:
slider.tool_tip: None, over drizzle, up to a full storm

slider.name: turbulence_slider
slider.label: Turbulence:
slider.tool_tip: How gusty precipitation arrives: steady fall, or waves and bursts

slider.name: wind_heading_slider
slider.label: Wind heading:
slider.tool_tip: Compass direction the wind blows toward. 0 is north, 90 is east

slider.name: wind_elevation_slider
slider.label: Wind elevation:
slider.tool_tip: Tilt of the wind off horizontal, degrees. Positive blows upward

slider.name: windspeed_slider
slider.label: Wind speed:
slider.tool_tip: Tilts the fall direction and drifts slow precipitation, m/s

slider.name: gust_depth_slider
slider.label: Gust depth:
slider.tool_tip: How hard the wind surges and drops as a gust front passes, on top of the turbulence above. 0 is a steady wind, 1 goes from near-lull to about double strength

slider.name: gust_length_slider
slider.label: Gust spacing:
slider.tool_tip: Metres between gust fronts along the wind. Divided by the wind speed this is how often a surge arrives: 140m in a 14m/s wind is a wave every ten seconds

slider.name: gust_veer_slider
slider.label: Gust veer:
slider.tool_tip: Degrees the wind swings either side of its heading as a gust goes through. A gust that only changes speed reads as the world pulsing rather than as weather

combo_box.name: preset_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Which weather preset this track runs

check_box.name: ground_check
check_box.label: Pin floor to altitude:
check_box.tool_tip: By default a sky track uses its own base altitude as ground zero. Pin it when the platform sits well above that

spinner.name: ground_spinner
spinner.tool_tip: Altitude precipitation lands on for this track, metres

slider.name: fallthrough_slider
slider.label: Fall through:
slider.tool_tip: How much precipitation is still drawn where there is no platform to catch it. Sky tracks are mostly open air, so this thins it out

check_box.label: Ripples and splashes where drops land
Impact sounds (from the preset sound pack)

button.name: reload_button
button.label: Reload parcel config
button.tool_tip: Re-read the parcel description and refetch the Atmo notecard it points at

line_editor.name: config_name_editor
line_editor.tool_tip: Name for this configuration; used when saving it out to a notecard

button.name: load_button
button.label: Load...
button.tool_tip: Opens your inventory filtered to notecards. Drag an Atmo notecard onto this floater to load it

button.name: save_button
button.label: Save As...
button.tool_tip: Write the current configuration out to a new notecard in your inventory

button.name: revert_button
button.label: Revert
button.tool_tip: Discard local edits and go back to the loaded configuration

button.name: defaults_button
button.label: Defaults
button.tool_tip: Clear everything back to system defaults: no track has weather

button.name: fx_button
button.label: Effects & LOD...
button.tool_tip: Density, particle budget, tier distances and ripple tuning

button.name: assets_button
button.label: Assets...
button.tool_tip: Global wind loops and generated-texture options

button.name: audio_button
button.label: Audio mix...
button.tool_tip: Volume of each sound category, echo amount and fade speed

button.name: sim_button
button.label: Simulation...
button.tool_tip: Rain shadow and wind flowmap resolution, tuning and rebuilds
